evidence: The crystallinity of the films was examined by X-ray diffraction (Philips MPD 1880, CUK(Y radiation). Atomic force microscopy (Nanoscope III) was used to study the surface morphology with the SiaNi, cantilever in a constant force mode. Thicknesses and refractive indexes of the films were evaluated by optical transmittance spectrometry (Hitachi spectrophotometer, model U 2000). For comparison, X-ray fluorescence (Philips PW 1480) was used to measure the average thicknesses of the films.
